conflicts.claim_as_written: On human judgments: we're scoping and staffing a human-rating annotation UI from scratch — Vera Egede owns the build at 50%, with Quentin supporting on the trajectory-replay backend — so raters can watch agent episodes and grade them on task completion, efficiency, and safety. I looked and there's nothing in our current tooling that does trajectory-level rating, so we're budgeting it as a ground-up build: first usable version end of June.
